summary: Choose a maintainable implementation structure that satisfies a specification and existing system constraints.

inputs.name: specification
inputs.description: Required behavior, acceptance criteria, and quality constraints.

inputs.name: project-context
inputs.description: Current structure, ownership, and integration paths.

inputs.name: impact-assessment
inputs.description: Known consumers, risks, and compatibility obligations.

inputs.name: security-assessment
inputs.description: Current security assessment evidence and its material constraints, when selected by risk or policy.

inputs.name: privacy-assessment
inputs.description: Current privacy assessment evidence and its material constraints, when selected by risk or policy.

inputs.name: experience-design
inputs.description: Current experience design evidence and its material constraints, when selected by risk or policy.

inputs.name: observability-plan
inputs.description: Current observability plan evidence and its material constraints, when selected by risk or policy.

inputs.name: migration-plan
inputs.description: Current migration plan evidence and its material constraints, when selected by risk or policy.

inputs.name: dependency-report
inputs.description: Current dependency report evidence and its material constraints, when selected by risk or policy.

inputs.name: performance-report
inputs.description: Current performance report evidence and its material constraints, when selected by risk or policy.

completion_checks: The chosen structure maps to requirements and existing ownership.
Consequential alternatives and tradeoffs are evaluated.
Verification, rollout, and recovery boundaries are explicit.
failure_modes: A missing constraint prevents a safe design choice: blocked.
Critical assumptions cannot be distinguished with available evidence: inconclusive.
